tools.name: generate_prompt
tools.description: Turns a rough idea ("cold email to a cafe owner", "a cat astronaut poster") into a detailed, structured prompt ready to paste into an AI tool. Returns the prompt text.

tools.name: improve_prompt
tools.description: Rewrites an existing prompt with the change the user asks for ("shorter", "add three examples", "for a B2B audience"). Returns the new prompt.
